description: This file defines an OverflowException class used within the ZipStream library to handle cases where a size exceeds the limit of a 32-bit integer.

classes.name: OverflowException
classes.description: An exception class thrown when a file size exceeds the 32-bit integer limit, suggesting enabling zip64 support.
